name: Mainstreet Iowa Apparel
old_description: Mainstreet Iowa Apparel specializes in quality screen printed and embroidered apparel. With full graphic design capability, competitive pricing, and quick turnarounds, we provide a full-service experience for your company, group, or organization!
about:
Mainstreet Iowa Apparel operates from Cedar Rapids, Iowa, where it was established to serve local businesses, schools, teams, and organizations with custom-decorated apparel. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but its leadership includes Vice President Anthony Hobson, graphic designer Curt Zebuhr, embroidery technician Cindy Knock, and marketing and inside sales lead Taylor Zebuhr.

The shop provides screen printing, embroidery, and specialty decoration services, supported by in-house graphic design and custom webstore creation. Screen printing is offered in single-color, multi-color, and special-effect options with access to the full Pantone color system. Embroidery covers polos, jackets, hats, bags, and other corporate wear. The company also maintains an apparel showroom for customers to evaluate garments before ordering.

Customers range from area businesses and educational institutions to sports teams and community organizations. The company emphasizes a local-partner approach, handling projects from concept through finished goods.

Mainstreet Iowa Apparel positions itself on quick turnarounds, competitive pricing, and a relationship-focused model rather than transactional order-taking. Its stated goal is to make the custom-apparel process easy and deliver results customers are proud to wear.
